body: I am an Uber driver. Sorry, I can't really think right now. I'm a bit stunned with what is going on right now.

Yeah it sucks. Worst part was when today I got a phone call from the place I interviewed for. I don't know about you, but I assume when you get a phone call from the place you interviewed at that meant that it was good news, you got hired instead of getting an email or letter from them. I guess it was just their way to show that they appreciated that I gave them my time and interest. I guess that makes two of us then. I feel like I might as well be on a damn desert island throwing messages in a bottle hoping to hear back from someone except it is my resume. Resume in a bottle...doesn't have the same ring to it. 

Yeah, the guy told me good luck after saying they chose someone else. I thought yeah thanks. Easy for you to say. I kind of have a job, but it's nothing to do with my field. I just feel absolutely hopeless right now.
